commands: queues="$(uv run --python 3.12 python -m ai_do_worker.queue_contract --celery-queues)" && AI_DO_WORKER_QUEUE_GROUP=all uv run --python 3.12 celery -A ai_do_worker.celery_app:celery_app worker --loglevel=info -Q "$queues"
AI_DO_WORKER_QUEUE_GROUP=beat uv run --python 3.12 celery -A ai_do_worker.celery_app:celery_app beat --loglevel=info

options.command: AI_DO_WORKER_BROKER_URL=memory:// AI_DO_WORKER_RESULT_BACKEND=cache+memory:// UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=../../.runtime/ci-worker-venv uv run --no-sync --frozen --python 3.12 --group dev python -m pytest tests -q
